question: Is the 2003 press figure 1,473 the printed AOB row count?

source_aob.path: PD/AOB.md (sanskrit-lexicon/PD, OCR of the official KoshaSHRI AOB.pdf)
source_aob.note: only one AOB printing exists in the estate (AOB.pdf); AOB_ocr.md is a second OCR pass of the same PDF, so no 2003-vintage AOB list can be tested

verdict.is_1473_the_printed_row_count: no -- not reproducible as the count
verdict.why: The printed AOB carries 1,469 entry rows once the 7 repeated column-header lines are removed from R1's 1,476; 1,473 is 4 above that and 50 above the careful parse (1,423 usable). Adding back the OCR-garbled entries R1 misses (R2, 99 candidate lines, an upper bound) a printed count of 1,473 is well inside the recoverable range, so the press figure CANNOT be excluded as the list count -- but no committed rule REPRODUCES it, so it is consistent with the printed row count rather than equal to it.
verdict.independence_reason: Three failures: (1) different measurement channel -- the figure is the project's own count of texts excerpted, given in a feature sourced to its director and coordinator, not an external count of the printed list; (2) different time slice -- 'first 25 years', catalogued by 1975, against a list printed with volumes 1976-2019 and OCR'd from the current PDF; (3) same producer -- the AOB and the press figure both originate at Deccan College, so relaying it is not an independent second measurement of that institution's own list.
verdict.evidentiary_value: A dateable corroboration of magnitude: by 2003 the project itself put its source corpus at ~1.47x, which rules out reading 1,419 or 1,118 as its own intended canon, and brackets the printed list from below. It must NOT be counted as a second independent witness.
verdict.correction_landed: H6923's structural estimate 1,476 includes 7 repeated column-header rows; the header-corrected printed entry-row count is 1,469, so 118/N = 8.03 % -- which still displays as the ruled 8.0 %, so no manuscript number moves.
